gloss: deposit; down payment securing a contract

definitions.gloss: deposit; earnest money securing a contract
definitions.explanation: Money paid by the buyer when a contract is concluded, confirming the agreement before the full price is paid. Common in real estate and large purchases; the buyer typically forfeits it if they back out, while the seller may owe double if they cancel.

examples.japanese: {契約時|けいやくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手付金|てつけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid a deposit when signing the contract.

examples.japanese: {手付金|てつけきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一割|いちわり}→一割：26078_ichiwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相場|そうば}→相場：07668_souba⟧だ。
examples.english: A deposit of ten percent of the property price is the going rate.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{主|ぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{手付金|てつけきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{返|かえ}って→返る：29164_kaeru⟧こない。
examples.english: If the buyer cancels for their own reasons, the deposit is not refunded.

notes:
Compound of {手付|てつけ} (earnest, deposit) + {金|きん} (money). Most often encountered in real-estate transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手付金|てつけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to put down a deposit
- {手付金|てつけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}する→放棄する：25353_houkisuru⟧: to forfeit the deposit
- {手付金|てつけきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧: refund of the deposit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭金|あたまきん}→頭金：29480_atamakin⟧: down payment — the first installment toward the price; reduces the balance owed
- ⟦{内金|うちきん}→内金：30223_uchikin⟧: part payment — money applied to the price, without the contract-securing function of {手付金|てつけきん}
